theme_and_brand.description: Enterprise-grade SDLC Governance & Assurance Platform. The UI must convey authority and absolute precision. It uses an 'EY-style' color mapping (Yellow/Black/White/Grey) but strictly with ZERO EY branding, logos, or trademarks. It operates entirely as an advisory, read-only layer (observing, never acting).
theme_and_brand.logo_instructions: DO NOT use any real-world brand logos. Create a simple abstract geometric shape (e.g., a pure black square with a sharp yellow dot in the corner) using raw Tailwind + HTML.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' / Swiss Brutalist hybrid. Sharp, authoritative headings contrasting with ultra-legible, dense monolinear data body text.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: High Density Grid (Bento Mode B). Every pixel matters. Extreme data visibility without clutter.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: The 'Technical' Look (Grid Borders). Do not use soft, floating cards. Use border-collapse style layouts with sharp 1px borders (border-border/60). Remove border-radius for an unyielding, serious enterprise feel (max rounded-sm).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict left-alignment for all data labels and values to optimize for fast visual scanning.

page_specific_patterns.dashboard_kpis: Top-left North Star metrics. Grouped in a strict 4-column subgrid. Large tabular numbers. Left-aligned.
page_specific_patterns.findings_explorer: Progressive disclosure layout. Left sidebar for filtering (Severity, Tags), main area for tri-state verdict lists. Drill-down pane on the right (Drawer/Sheet) for masked evidence.
page_specific_patterns.traceability_matrix: Dense matrix table bridging Requirements ↔ Design ↔ Commit ↔ Test. Highlight coverage % in yellow accents.
page_specific_patterns.ledger_audit_trail: Immutable event sourcing display. Use IBM Plex Mono for SHA-256 hash chains. Feature a prominent 'Verify Ledger Integrity' button.
page_specific_patterns.gate_readiness: Advisory human-decision screen. G1-G10 mapped strictly. Use accordion/collapsible panels to show readiness vs missing artifacts.
page_specific_patterns.ai_governance: ISO/IEC 42001 alignment (AI-01 to AI-16). Matrix view showing platform verification provenance chips (Platform/Client/Unattributed).

visual_enhancers.borders: Heavy use of 1px solid borders (border-[#E2E2E6]) to separate data regions. No soft shadows. Optional 4px left-borders to denote status (Red/Green/Yellow).
visual_enhancers.backgrounds: Solid white and off-white. No gradients. No glassmorphism. This is a secure audit environment; visual refraction implies obfuscation.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with a sharp, 1.5px or 2px stroke width. Straightforward and unambiguous.

motion_and_interactions.strategy: Instantaneous. Snappy. No long fades or bounces.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Immediate background color shifts (e.g., table row hover).
motion_and_interactions.modals_drawers: Slide in from right (Sheet component) for evidence drill-downs. No bounce effect.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Black on Yellow, Black on White, White on Black.
accessibility.screen_reader: All icon-only buttons must have aria-labels. Tabular data must use proper <th> and scope attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React (.js) using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components. Do not use TypeScript.
STRICT RULE: NO EY logos, NO EY branding, NO trademarked assets. Create a generic geometric placeholder logo.
STRICT RULE: Yellow (#FFE600) is ONLY for accents, primary CTAs, and highlights. Do not use yellow for large background areas or it will cause eye strain.
STRICT RULE: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, dropdowns, buttons, and critical data cells for test automation.
STRICT RULE: Implement the 'Read-only · Advisory' badge prominently in the persistent global header.
STRICT RULE: Ensure the Role Switcher dropdown dynamically impacts the visibility/permissions of the dashboard modules.
Use Shadcn's '<Select>' component for the Role Switcher.
Use Shadcn's '<Sheet>' component for the Findings Evidence drill-down.
Use Shadcn's '<Table>' component extensively for high-density ledgers, matrices, and control catalogs.
Use Recharts (styled sharply, no rounded bars, straight lines, sharp tooltips) for trend charts.
Include 'IBM Plex Mono' (or generic monospace) for the SHA-256 hash chains in the ledger integrity view.
Do NOT center-align the application. Left-align everything. It is a dense B2B tool.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make it crisp, sharp, and authoritative.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through border grids and tight padding, NOT through heavy box-shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Apply to specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (sharp corners for this enterprise tool) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (e.g., hover background color shift).
